tools.title: HOMA-IR (Insulin Resistance)
tools.description: Homeostatic model assessment of insulin resistance from fasting insulin and glucose (mg/dL or mmol/L).

tools.title: FIB-4 (Liver Fibrosis)
tools.description: FIB-4 index from age, AST, ALT and platelet count, with low / indeterminate / high probability of advanced fibrosis.

tools.title: Lab Report Analyser (Check-up Package)
tools.description: Upload a lab report PDF or photo and get eGFR, FIB-4, PREVENT CV risk with 2026 lipid targets, lipid indices, NLR, osmolality, vitamin D target, differentials and lifestyle advice; runs in the browser.
